selection_reason: A-MEM has NeurIPS 2025 publication strength and an official reproduction repository.
The exact-pinned 2026-03-05 upstream revision adds an official robust local path via Ollama/vLLM, including qwen2.5:3b, so no paid API is structurally required.
A-MEM's source surface is materially smaller than TiMem/MemoryOS/Graphiti and therefore offers the best balance of scientific strength, relevance, exact pinning, and zero-cost feasibility.

TiMem ranks second because it directly targets both LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S and is accepted to Findings of ACL 2026, but its self-hosted stack requires PostgreSQL/Qdrant plus LLM services and is materially heavier.
